name: Golden Gate Bridge
note: The NEAR level of the bridge (BUGS.md #211). tools/cities.ts's `skyline` entry is the FAR level; Landmarks.update() disables it once the rider is within 1.3 km of THIS model's rectangle, so there is one bridge, not two. Position and bearing fitted to the ridden roadway (tools/bridge-fit.ts: within 0.8 m of the axis over the whole span). baseY -84.51 is the city's sea level (the datum frame's MSL, BUGS.md #227 — the index does not carry seaLevel, so it is written here): the model stands at its real height, and since 2026-09-29 the ways over it take their heights from its declared deck (src/city/bridge-decks.ts, golden-gate.ts GOLDEN_GATE_DECKS) rather than the model being sunk 18 m to meet them. `coversRaised` suppresses the OSM extruded slab, its generic piers and the `building:part` tower stacks under the same footprint.

name: Bay Bridge
note: The NEAR level of the Bay Bridge's west span (the far level is tools/cities.ts's skyline entry of the same name, which takes this entry's place and datum). baseY -84.51 is the city's sea level. The ways over it — the lower deck eastbound, the upper westbound, the approach over Rincon Hill, the viaduct and the tunnel on Yerba Buena — take their heights from its declared decks (bay-bridge.ts BAY_BRIDGE_DECKS, src/city/bridge-decks.ts), which run well past this footprint: the footprint is only what the MODEL draws (tower to tower and the two anchorages), and `coversRaised` stops the generic slab and piers being drawn inside it.
